min_notional_preflight: Design 8:241 and 22.4:852 - the LEGACY runtime carries instrument_min_notional 0 while the corrected frozen InstrumentRecord carries minimum_notional 101. Order notional 1 * 100 * 1 = 100. Corrected admits iff 100 >= 101, which is false, so the corrected adapter refuses REFUSED_MIN_NOTIONAL and opens no position; the legacy strict comparison 100 < 0 is false, so legacy opens. Both thresholds are now explicit scenario inputs at design 22.4:852 rather than prose-only values.
